summary: BSF reported record H1 2026 net income of 2.868B riyals, up 5% YoY; EPS of 0.4867 beat forecast by 0.64%, revenue matched at $2.7B.
Loan growth remained strong at 7% YoY with deposits up 5%; net interest margin declined 7 bps to 304 bps amid higher funding costs.
Bank tightened full-year cost-of-risk guidance to 45-50 bps from 45-55 bps; expects cost-to-income ratio below 33% for 2026.
Management maintained high single-digit loan growth target; forecasts NIM around 3% assuming stable rates through year-end.
Shares rose 3.8% to $20.48 in after-hours trading before settling at $19.80; executives emphasized disciplined growth under Strategy 2030.
